format: one JSON object per line; complete evaluated set, not only errors

required.prediction: original prediction text, including empty string when generated
required.finished: boolean; false if decoding reached its limit without EOS
required.score: finite number in [0,1], using a declared upstream scorer
required.protocol_id: hash/identity of task/scoring/generation contract shared by matched arms
required.method_protocol_id: hash/identity of this arm's implementation and resolved decoder configuration
required.input_id: hash/identity of the exact question, image, and frozen prompt
required.evidence_id: native evidence-cache identity; empty only for an independently declared no-evidence arm
required.delivered_source_group_ids: ordered array of selected and actually delivered source-group IDs; [] for generalist
required.run_id: identifier linking to the immutable P0 run ledger

optional.cluster_id: deidentified patient ID preferred for resampling
optional.rendered_evidence_sha256: ordered hashes of the exact text/structured renderings shown to the receiver
optional.source_context_tokens: context-token counts by source and joint arm
optional.answer_type: CE or short OE; report generation is evaluated separately
optional.model_forwards: receiver forward calls for this case/arm
optional.wall_seconds: receiver decoding time, excluding separately reported native expert acquisition
optional.raw_or_repair: raw or named deterministic answer-blind repair protocol
optional.trace: candidate, anchor, selected token and commit reason if retained
optional.branch_score_ref: reference to same-prefix receiver branch scores when retained

notes: No real example rows are fabricated.
Different method rows must agree on the original input_id, scorer, receiver checkpoint, frozen native source identities and evaluated ID set for paired comparisons.
The shared protocol_id identifies the common task contract; method_protocol_id identifies the intentionally different arm implementation. A generation/scoring change requires a new relevant identity.
Preserve empty, unfinished and unparsed rows with score 0 only when that is the declared upstream scorer rule; never silently drop them.
Full raw branch logits are not needed for Stage 1 paired score analysis, but Stage 2 zero-inference replay requires the actual same-prefix branch scores.
